Commands to start WTS:
cd /opt/wts/latest
sudo ./edaemon --port 22222
./egate --port 20000
	
After WTS/egate started, Setup NG/X2 from egate:
telnet 0 20000
cfg_sim file=D202_gnb3_wts.cfg
enb_x2_link_up enb=1 target=2  

// UE1 DRB1(non-GBR), NSA cell1+cell4
ue_attach id=51
ue_dc_enb_start ue=51 target_gnb=2 target_cells=1 bearer=2 type=split_scg
trf_data_start ue=51 id=2 dir=ul mbps=20 trf_id=1
trf_data_start ue=51 id=2 dir=dl mbps=50 trf_id=1

//UE2 DRB2(nonGBR),DRB3(nonGBR),DRB4(GBR) SA cell 11+cell2
ue_register id=2
set_pdu_param ue=2 pdu=1 trf_type=internal
ue_pdu_session_setup pdu=1 ue=2 nwslice=1 gw=1
ue_pdu_session_modify ue=2 pdu=1 qosflows_to_add=2,7 by=amf

trf_data_start ue=2 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=ul mbps=5
trf_data_start ue=2 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=dl mbps=5
trf_data_start ue=2 pdu=1 qfi=2 dir=ul mbps=1
trf_data_start ue=2 pdu=1 qfi=2 dir=dl mbps=1
trf_data_start ue=2 pdu=1 qfi=3 dir=ul mbps=1
trf_data_start ue=2 pdu=1 qfi=3 dir=dl mbps=1

//UE3 VONR (DRB5(5QI=5),DRB6(5QI1) SA cell1
ue_register id=3
set_pdu_param ue=3 pdu=1 trf_type=internal
ue_pdu_session_setup pdu=1 ue=3
ue_pdu_session_modify ue=3 pdu=1 qosflows_to_add=5 by=amf
trf_data_start ue=3 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=ul Kbps=20
trf_data_start ue=3 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=dl Kbps=20
trf_data_start ue=3 pdu=1 qfi=2 dir=ul Kbps=20
trf_data_start ue=3 pdu=1 qfi=2 dir=dl Kbps=20

//UE4 DBR7(5QI-2) SA cell1
ue_register id=4
set_pdu_param ue=4 pdu=1 trf_type=internal
ue_pdu_session_setup pdu=1 ue=4
trf_data_start ue=4 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=ul mbps=1
trf_data_start ue=4 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=dl mbps=1

//UE5 DRB8(5QI=6) xn HO to cell1，addGbrTrafficHo，includeSrbToAddModList=true
gnb_param id=3 sib1_period=40
gnb_param id=3 sib2_period=40
gnb_param id=3 sib5_period=40
ib_enb_cell_disp enb=3 cell=1
ue_history_information_list_add_ngran id=1 gnb_id=2 cell_type=small nrcgi=310:260|0x03 time_ue_stayed_in_cell=100
ue_history_information_list_add_ngran id=1 cell_type=large gnb_id=3 nrcgi=310:260|0x03 time_ue_stayed_in_cell=100
ue_history_information_list id=1 action=commit
ue_enb_param id=1 ue_history_list=1
ue_change_location id=1 enb=3 cell=1

gnb_xn_link_up gnb=3 target=2

ue_register id=1 ue_nr_

ue_summary
set_pdu_param ue=1 pdu=1 trf_type=internal
ue_pdu_session_setup pdu=1 ue=1 nwslice=1 gw=1

trf_data_start ue=1 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=ul mbps=5
trf_data_start ue=1 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=dl mbps=5

ue_summary
ue_cfg_meas_disp id=1
amf_ue_ng_handover_request_param id=1 ue=1 object_id=1 location_reporting_reference_id=1 trace_activation=on tce_ip=10.0.1.1:49151 trace_depth=maximum ifaces_to_trace=NG-C,Xn-C,Uu,F1-C,E1 trace_plmn=310:260 trace_ref_id=1 trace_rec_session_ref_id=1
ue_cfg_meas_disp id=1
ue_measurement_send_nr id=1 meas_id=1 event=A3 srsrp_nr=60 srsrq_nr=60 phycell_id=51 nrsrp_nr=80 nrsrq_nr=80


//UE6:DRB9(non-GBR),DRB10(non-GBR) SA CELL1 一个接一个
ue_register id=6
set_pdu_param ue=6 pdu=1 trf_type=internal
ue_pdu_session_setup pdu=1 ue=6
trf_data_start ue=6 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=ul mbps=5
trf_data_start ue=6 pdu=1 qfi=1 dir=dl mbps=5

ue_pdu_session_modify ue=6 pdu=1 qosflows_to_add=2 by=amf 
trf_data_start ue=6 pdu=1 qfi=2 dir=ul mbps=5
trf_data_start ue=6 pdu=1 qfi=2 dir=dl mbps=5

//RELEAES UE2
trf_data_stop ue=2 pdu=1
ue_deregister id=2 ue_deregister_type=switch_off

//release all UE
trf_data_stop ue=51
trf_data_stop ue=3 pdu=1
trf_data_stop ue=4 pdu=1
trf_data_stop ue=1 pdu=1
trf_data_stop ue=6 pdu=1
ue_detach id=51
ue_deregister id=3 ue_deregister_type=switch_off
ue_deregister id=4 ue_deregister_type=switch_off
ue_deregister id=1 ue_deregister_type=switch_off
ue_deregister id=6 ue_deregister_type=switch_off


sudo ip addr add 10.0.2.91/24 dev eth3
sudo ip addr add 10.0.1.123/24 dev eth3
sudo ip addr add 10.0.1.122/24 dev eth3
sudo ip addr add 10.0.2.90/24 dev eth3
sudo ip addr add 10.0.1.30/24 dev eth3
